'''2018 European MPC Results Grady Hutchins DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Grady Hutchins]] at [[2018 European Match Play Championship]] (Results).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Grady Hutchins]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open ISB Hutchins DS 2018 MPC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-match-play-championships/ PC list]
